Directory research 2026-10-04: Touring tribute act (not Long Island-based; agent is in NJ) that plays Long Island theaters. The band's own site is branded "The Glimmer Twins" but its shows are billed as Classic Stones Live. Phone is the booking agency's office line from the agency page; the band's contact page gives the agent's cell instead (not recorded). The X account (stonestribute1) is linked from the band site but may be inactive. Some site photos carry a "LOVE images" photographer watermark and were skipped. No Instagram, YouTube channel or Spotify found.
description: An eight-piece Rolling Stones tribute band led by look-alikes of Mick Jagger (Keith Call) and Keith Richards (Bernie Bollendorf). They recreate a classic Stones concert with the big hits and tour theaters around the Northeast, including the Patchogue Theatre.
